sequence.name: Connected Cozy and Shared Automated Play
Recovery, Safety, Acceptance and Implementation Handoff

design_rules: Connected Cozy is invited-participant shared play, not public matchmaking.
Shared automation remains APM-01 bounded and owning-domain authorized.
Participant permissions are never pooled; host cannot consent/spend/choose for another human.
Resource contributions use deterministic reserve/commit/release semantics.
APW-06 authorization-before-aggregation and visibility rules govern shared surfaces and AI context.
Async and live co-op share one authoritative history/order model.
Optional AI is presentation/proposal only; no-AI path required.
non_goals: No unbounded autonomous shared campaign generation.
No multiplayer AutoGM authority in APM-05.
